title: Easy Whipped Peanut Butter Pie
description: This easy-to-make pie pairs a creamy whipped peanut butter filling with a chocolate cookie crust, making it great for holidays, parties, or any occasion.
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, softened to room temperature
1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®), thawed
1 (9 inch) prepared chocolate cookie pie crust (such as Oreo®)
2 tablespoons chocolate syrup, or to taste

steps.text: Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar with an electric mixer until creamy. Mix in peanut butter until incorporated. Add whipped topping and mix until fluffy.
Pour mixture into the pie crust. Cover and freeze for at least 2 hours.
When ready to serve, remove pie from the freezer and let thaw for 10 to 15 minutes. Drizzle with chocolate syrup and serve.
